main_text.p: nostra instructio, in sui temporis magistratus infideles, barbaros, tyrannicos; & nos qui Christiani dicimur, in Principes Christianos debacchamur? insurgimus? ille faciem sputo & alapis, scapulas flagris, linguam felli & aceto, caput spinis, totum denique corpus cruci submisit, cùm esset & facto innocens, & ad vindictam potens, & nos Christianorum Principum autoritatem, linguis proscindere, gladijs iugula impetere non veremur? fac, bone Iesu, quæ-sumus, fac tandem ut cognoscat & agnoscat mundus hos sicarios, ad tuam nullatenùs pertinere familiam: sed ad eius satellitium; qui etiam, teipso teste, homicida fuit ab initio.
main_text.head: CAP. XV.
main_text.p: SAluator nostèr in Euangelio, cum discipulis suam oblationem breui futuram praedixisset; praehensum eum Mat.16.Petrus coepit obiurgare, dicens, Ne-quaquam erit tibihoc, ac si dixisset, Ne despon-

page.notes: The initial S of "Saluator" is a large woodcut-style initial, transcribed as "SAluator". The marginal note mark is "n", matching the note "Mat.16." on the right. The word "tibihoc" is printed without a space and is copied as printed. The paragraph breaks mid-word at "despon-" and continues on the next page. The left edge shows part of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. No catchword or signature is visible.
